messages:
marta: quick sync - doing a private-installer transport dry-run tonight 22:00 UTC to a small VPC canary set. focus: cosign, prefetch, and deploy-bot backoff.
tasha: I'll run cosign verify + sha checks preflight. sharing commands.
liam: quorum = 3 healthy escorts per region. if cosign fails -> immediate abort and repin.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled dry-run 5411110000 -> throttle=50%, window=30m. posting progress.
tasha: cosign verify OK on initial mirror; rehydrated signature cache.
marta: rollback thresholds: >3% delivery failures OR any cosign mismatch OR KMS unrecoverable error -> abort. 1-3% -> pause and triage 15m.
liam: on high handshake latency (>600s) auto-reduce concurrency to 10%.
deploy-bot: dry-run progress: 3/4 escorts OK, 1 had transient retry. no cosign errors.
marta: if clear, staged pin at 23:30 UTC with throttle=25% and a 60-minute watch window. tasha signoff at 23:15.
tasha: will post signoff after tailing transport.log. all green so far.
liam: add metric alert: cosign verify p95 >2s -> abort.
marta: thanks, will escalate if anything odd.
